notes: NOCTURNE — a monochrome single-page atlas of the night train. Twelve real sleeper services (1883 to today) presented as a split-flap departures board, a hand-drawn Beck-style route diagram, per-service night sequences, and four short elegies. Static HTML/CSS/JS with no dependencies and no external requests; the split-flap engine is DOM + Web Animations, board clacks are synthesized with the Web Audio API (off by default), the diagram is hand-authored SVG. Fully responsive, keyboard accessible, motion respects prefers-reduced-motion, works from file:// and GitHub Pages subpaths. Known limitations: timetable times are indicative rather than authoritative (stated on the page) and the diagram is deliberately schematic, not to scale.
